the risk of postoperative infection after colorectal resections is reduced by pre-storage leukodepletion, and by bedside leukodepletion, but not by bedside filtration.

(1) the use of prestorage filtered leukoreduced blood transfusion in patients undergoing colorectal resection was associated with a reduction of infective morbidity and (2) bedside filtered leukoreduction of blood transfusions was associated with a similar reduction in infective morbidity.
